title: Synthetic translation regression fixture; not a real paper

context.text: 此合成片段研究仿真中的控制策略；尚未确认真实机器人表现。

units.source: The control policy may reduce tracking error by 12% in simulation, provided that sensor latency remains below 20 ms. [[CITE:r1]]
This does not establish that the method improves performance on a real robot.
[[IMG:fig1]] Figure 1. (a) Training; (b) evaluation. Error bars show standard deviation, not standard error.
The laboratory safety policy requires supervision during every experiment.
